value.title: Marie Thérèse, Madame Royale
value.extract: Marie Thérèse of France (2 January 1667 – 1 March 1672) was a French princess, a fille de France. She was the fourth child of King Louis XIV and Queen Maria Theresa. As the eldest surviving daughter of a French king, she was known at court by the traditional honorific Madame Royale.
